name: Moujuutsukai to Ouji-sama ~Snow Bride~
original_name: 猛獣使いと王子様 ～Snow Bride～
source:
The game contains three sections for each character. 
The first is another story where Tiana picks who she will go to the ball at Kurt’s castle with. 
The second is the after story, which is the main dish of the game that continues after the first game’s ending for each guy (but before the epilogues). 
Lastly there are bonus extras for each character called “diaries” where you get to see cute scenes that happened “during the last game” and you also get to pet (and now tickle) your favorite furry friends.

[Edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2011/03/05/otome-game-review-moujuutsukai-to-oujisama-snow-bride/]Hinano's Game Babbles[/url]]
translation:
本作每名角色都拥有三个部分。

第一部分是另一篇故事，描写蒂安娜选择与谁一同参加库尔特城堡的舞会。
第二部分是游戏的主菜——后日谈，承接前作各男主角结局，但发生在尾声之前。
最后，每名角色还有名为“日记”的附加内容，可以看到“前作期间”发生的可爱场景，也能抚摸——现在还可以挠痒——心爱的毛茸茸伙伴。

[根据 [url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2011/03/05/otome-game-review-moujuutsukai-to-oujisama-snow-bride/]Hinano's Game Babbles[/url]修改]
